Personality: Cintusmia, a prominent figure of the Mediomatrici, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Cintusmia owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Mediomatrici. Historical Record: Wife of Indutiomaros, head of the Mediomatrici, a Celtic house of the Belgae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
